title: Apply Security Settings
description: Enable HTTPS‑related settings and set ALLOWED_HOSTS.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

Add security settings to your production configuration:
- Set `ALLOWED_HOSTS` to your domain (e.g., `['example.com']`).
- Set `SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = True` and `CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE = True`.
- Set `SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT = True` (if you have HTTPS).
- Optionally, set `SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS = 31536000`.

Test that these settings don't break development by using environment variables to conditionally apply them (e.g., only when `DEBUG=False`).
hints: You can wrap the settings in an `if not DEBUG:` block.
For ALLOWED_HOSTS, you can also read from env: `ALLOWED_HOSTS = config('ALLOWED_HOSTS', default='localhost').split(',')`.
expectedOutput: When `DEBUG=False`, the security headers are sent and HTTPS is enforced (if behind a reverse proxy).
solutionCode:
# settings.py
if not DEBUG:
    ALLOWED_HOSTS = ['yourdomain.com']
    SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = True
    CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE = True
    SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT = True
    SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS = 31536000
    SECURE_HSTS_INCLUDE_SUBDOMAINS = True
    SECURE_HSTS_PRELOAD = True
    SECURE_CONTENT_TYPE_NOSNIFF = True
    SECURE_BROWSER_XSS_FILTER = True
